verdict.rationale: TaxJar's AutoFile feature runs autonomously in the background to file and remit state tax returns without manual intervention, and its API enables automated tax calculations/transaction sync, but there's no evidence of a broader agentic automation framework, webhooks/triggers, or AI-native workflow orchestration beyond these two specific autonomous features. Missing for 10: evidence of general-purpose automation/workflow builder, event-driven triggers or webhooks, scheduling beyond tax filing, and any AI-agent-specific automation tooling.
